name: Lemongrass
target: Long arching flat grass blades and pale overlapping basal leaf sheaths.

name: Tulip
target: Blue-green strap leaves, closed red bud and open six-tepal red cup.

name: Daffodil
target: Narrow strap leaves and yellow six-tepal blooms with orange-gold trumpet coronas.

name: Crocus
target: Low purple six-tepal cups with golden centers and narrow white-striped leaves.

name: Hyacinth
target: Fleshy strap leaves and a dense upright raceme of blue-violet tubular florets.
